# Peters Agricultural & Groundworks Ltd

> Agricultural contracting and groundworks run by brothers James and Harry Peters from the family farm in Silverstone, Northamptonshire (NN12). Company number 16613206. Phone 07712 229940, email peters.agworks@outlook.com.

Areas: Northamptonshire, Buckinghamshire, Warwickshire, Oxfordshire and Leicestershire, mostly round Silverstone, Towcester, Brackley and Buckingham.

## Services

- [Hedge cutting](https://petersagri.co.uk/hedge-cutting/): tractor-mounted flail for field, roadside, paddock and long garden hedges. Farm hedges can be cut 1 September to the end of February.
- [Haulage](https://petersagri.co.uk/haulage/): straw and hay, machinery on the low loader, stone and aggregates, compost and woodchip.
- [Tanking](https://petersagri.co.uk/tanking/): slurry spreading, slurry haulage and water spreading.
- [Digger services](https://petersagri.co.uk/digger-works/): excavation, drainage, ditching, site clearance and preparation, groundworks, tree shearing.
- [Tractor services](https://petersagri.co.uk/tractor-works/): topping, baling, muck spreading and carting, grain and silage carting, dump carting, snow clearing.
